defs.def: a liquid obtained from petroleum, used as fuel in car engines, etc. 汽油

ex.s: Whether you ride a bicycle, you don’t use petrol.
ex.t: 所以它们不产生二氧化碳，也不会造成空气污染。

ex.s: The road novel, the road movie, these are the most typical American ideas, born of abundant petrol, cheap cars and a never-ending interstate highway system, the largest public works project in history.
ex.t: 1928年赫伯特·胡佛想象了一个"每户锅里都有鸡、每个车库都有车"的美国。从那时起，这个社会一直在向前发展，从不回头，因为汽车将美国从一个以农业为基础的社会转变为工业强国。

ex.s: Well, while I was sleeping, Dad stopped for some petrol and Mum also got out to take photos, and you can guess the rest...
ex.t: 嗯，在我睡觉的时候，爸爸停下来加油，妈妈也下车拍照，后面的你们可以猜到……

ex.s: Examples include burns caused by electric shocks, burning clothes, or petrol fires.
ex.t: 例子包括由电击、燃烧的衣服或汽油火灾造成的烧伤。

ex.s: I can't understand whypeoplealwaysdrivecars,evenfora short journeywhenthey couldwalk.Even though in recent years, the price of petrol goes up, people still 7 to use their cars.
ex.t: 我不明白为什么人们总是开车，哪怕是步行就可以的短途。尽管近年来油价上涨，人们仍然______使用汽车。

ex.s: Eating and drinking right Like cars that run on petrol, your body burns carbohydrates for energy.
ex.t: 正确饮食 就像汽车靠汽油行驶一样，你的身体燃烧碳水化合物来获取能量。

ex.s: Mars has plenty of metals and rock, and probably lots of water, but no wood or petroleum, which is used to make petrol, plastic and many other useful products.
ex.t: 火星上有大量的金属和岩石，可能还有大量的水，但没有木材或石油，石油被用来制造汽油、塑料和许多其他有用的产品。
